technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C):
Kontrol edin:  Technical Product Information (TPI) 2016824.  2016824 states to disconnect battery for at least 10 seconds, reconnect battery, and turn ignition on, step on brake pedal then operate parking brake for 2 cycles.  ReKontrol edin: DTCs and clear.
Kontrol edin:  Technical Product Information (TPI) 2017924 / TSB 46-08-04 for updated EPB (Electronic Parking Brake) Generation II (MY 2006-2007)  switch.  The switch was updated prior to Generation III vehicle production and should not affect MY 2008 or newer.
